name: Electronic Specialties Inc
old_description: Since 1967 Electronics Specialties, Inc. has been helping automotive and industrial technicians diagnose electrical problems faster with specialized testing equipment. For diagnosing circuits, batteries, engines and other electrical components, no other company has the product line and support team like us. See some of the awards and patents for our innovative and time-saving products. Check out current new arrivals for the latest innovative electrical and diagnostic tools in the industry.
about:
Electronic Specialties, Inc. was founded in 1967 in Genoa City, Wisconsin. The company has operated from this location for over five decades, building a focus on electrical testing equipment for technicians.

The company designs and manufactures a range of handheld electrical testing equipment and diagnostic tools. Its product lines include relay testers such as the Super Relay Buddy and Universal Relay Buddy, digital multimeters, clamp meters, current probes, test lead kits, infrared thermometers, and training books. Manufacturing and design operations are conducted in-house, though facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Electronic Specialties serves the automotive, small engine, HVAC, and industrial sectors. Its tools are used by automotive and industrial technicians for diagnosing circuits, batteries, engines, and other electrical components. The company markets directly to technicians and through distribution channels.

The company emphasizes its broad product line and dedicated support team as key differentiators, noting that it holds industry awards and patents for innovative, time-saving products. Free shipping is offered on orders over $75.
